Transform Business Networking with Our AI-Powered Matchmaking App

In today’s fast-paced exhibition halls and conference centers, meaningful connections can make or break your event’s success. At Positive d.o.o. in Novi Sad, we’re dedicated to guiding your digital transformation journey with innovative AI solutions. Our Business Matchmaking App is designed to streamline and supercharge the way exhibitors, seminar attendees, and event organizers find their ideal partners—saving time, energizing networking, and maximizing ROI.

Why AI-Driven Business Matchmaking Matters

Traditional matchmaking at trade shows, seminars, and conferences often relies on manual spreadsheets, chance encounters, or one-size-fits-all contact lists. This approach can be:

  • Time-consuming: Manually vetting hundreds of participants.
  • Inaccurate: Overlooking the nuances of company goals, service relevance, or collaboration potential.
  • Unscalable: Hard to repeat for multiple events or large attendee lists.

By harnessing the power of artificial intelligence, our app automates the entire business matchmaking pipeline—transforming raw data into targeted introductions in just minutes.

How Our Business Matchmaking Pipeline Works

  1. Questionnaire & Data Ingestion
    Using our assistant app Upitnik, participants complete a tailored questionnaire. Responses are automatically converted from answer forms into a validated JSON dataset, ensuring clean, consistent input for the next steps.
  2. Web & LinkedIn Enrichment
    Every participant record is enriched with concise, AI-generated summaries of their company website and LinkedIn profile. This provides deep context on each attendee’s expertise, industry focus, and collaboration interests.
  3. AI-Powered Pairwise Scoring
    Our core engine leverages a large language model (LLM) to score every unique participant pair. It combines structured compatibility metrics (e.g., industry, services offered, company size) with free-text summaries for a balanced, nuanced match score.
  4. Top-n Match Extraction
    After scoring, the app automatically extracts each participant’s top matches—those with the highest potential for collaboration.
  5. Personalized Email Drafts
    To jumpstart the conversation, the app drafts personalized matchmaking emails (in any language of your choice). Organizers can review, tweak, and send these ready-to-use templates directly from the console.

All steps are orchestrated via a single entry point, making the solution fully automated, yet flexible enough to include human-in-the-loop review when needed.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Automated Web & LinkedIn Summaries
    Gain actionable insights without leaving your dashboard.
  • Weighted Scoring Algorithm
    Blend structured criteria with AI-driven text analysis for optimal matches.
  • Top-n Match Lists
    Instantly identify and prioritize high-value connections.
  • Multi-language Email Drafts
    Generate culturally and linguistically appropriate outreach in seconds.
  • Agentic Orchestration
    Fully automated agents decide when and how to run each step—reducing manual overhead.

Benefits for Exhibitors and Organizers

  • Enhanced Efficiency: Eliminate manual pairing tasks and focus on high-level strategy.
  • Data-Driven Accuracy: Rely on AI to uncover match potentials that human operators might miss.
  • Scalability: From small seminars to large international expos, our pipeline handles any volume seamlessly.
  • Personal Touch: Boost engagement with customized outreach that feels genuine.
  • Measurable Results: Track open rates and meeting requests to quantify matchmaking success.

Why Choose Positive d.o.o.?

As a leading digital transformation consultant in Serbia, Positive d.o.o. blends deep AI expertise with practical industry know-how. Our team in Novi Sad has successfully delivered AI-driven chatbots, compliance automation tools, and now, this Business Matchmaking App—each designed to deliver measurable business impact. When you partner with us, you gain:

  • Proven AI Solutions: Tested in real-world event scenarios.
  • Customized Support: Tailored implementation, training, and ongoing optimization.
  • Local Expertise, Global Standards: Based in Serbia, serving international clients with cutting-edge technology.

Ready to Revolutionize Your Next Event?

Don’t let networking opportunities slip away. Embrace the future of event matchmaking with our AI-powered Business Matchmaking App. Contact Positive d.o.o. today to schedule a demo and discover how intelligent matchmaking can drive meaningful connections and tangible business growth.
